title: 20-Minute Oven Baked Crispy Chicken Cutlets
description: No egg or flour needed — chicken cutlets are coated in mayo or Greek yogurt, pressed into a seasoned panko-parmesan crust, and baked at high heat for a fast weeknight dinner with genuine crunch.

vegetarian.notes: Make a separate batch using thick slices of halloumi or portobello mushrooms in place of the chicken. Coat and bake the same way at 425°F for about 10 minutes, flipping once — they can share the other half of the sheet pan.

ingredients.note: spray or drizzle over tops before baking

rawText:
20 minute oven baked crispy chicken cutlets, no egg or flour needed!

Ingredients:
4 chicken breasts, sliced thin into 8 cutlets
2 cups panko breadcrumbs
¾ cup grated parmesan
3–4 tbsp mayo or plain Greek yogurt
1½ tsp garlic powder
1 tsp paprika
1 tsp salt
½ tsp pepper
Olive oil spray or drizzle

Instructions:
Preheat oven to 425°F.
Slice each chicken breast in half horizontally to make 8 thin cutlets.
Pat chicken dry and lightly coat each piece with mayo or yogurt - not too thick.
In a bowl mix:
panko
parmesan
garlic powder
paprika
salt + pepper
Press chicken into breadcrumb mixture really well.
Place on a parchment-lined sheet pan and spray/drizzle tops with olive oil.
Bake:
12–15 minutes
flip
bake another 5–8 minutes
Broil 1–2 minutes at the end for extra crispiness.

Thin cutlets cook fast, so don’t overbake them!
sourceNotes: The recipe title says 20 minutes but the bake time alone is 17–23 minutes plus broil; totalTimeMin set to 30 to include prep.
